decision: Comparison uses each public lossy default, including its alpha behavior. Exact default alpha is a PureJsImage guarantee; do not call another wrapper incorrect merely for lossy alpha it does not promise to preserve. Preserve every measured alpha error and black/white score. Historical timing values and original statuses are retained.
